title: Injective resolution computes the cohomology presheaf
statement: For an injective resolution I of an abelian sheaf F, the presheaf obtained by objectwise homology of the evaluated resolution is naturally isomorphic to F.cohomologyPresheaf q.

proof.text: The assertion follows from the objectwise kernel, image, and Ext comparison calculations described in the module docstring.

lean.statement: theorem Sheaf.injectiveResolution_cohomologyPresheaf {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C} [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{v}] [HasExt.{v} (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v})] {F : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v}} (I : InjectiveResolution F) (q : ℕ) : Nonempty ((((sheafToPresheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v}).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex).asFunctor ⋙ HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor _ (ComplexShape.up ℕ) q ≅ F.cohomologyPresheaf q)
